Comparison brief: Pinecrest Edge vs Marlstone Edge
evidence_dose=-4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Pinecrest Edge)

- p1: cache hit ratio: Pinecrest Edge=0.938  | Marlstone Edge=0.962 ← better
- p2: PoP count: Pinecrest Edge=245  | Marlstone Edge=310 ← better
- p3: TLS handshake p95 (ms): Pinecrest Edge=52  | Marlstone Edge=38 ← better
- p4: egress cost ($/TB): Pinecrest Edge=55  | Marlstone Edge=41 ← better
- p5: purge propagation (s): Pinecrest Edge=9  | Marlstone Edge=4 ← better
- p6: origin shield offload: Pinecrest Edge=0.79  | Marlstone Edge=0.88 ← better
- p7: config rollout time (min): Pinecrest Edge=7  | Marlstone Edge=3 ← better
- p8: annual availability (%): Pinecrest Edge=99.951  | Marlstone Edge=99.985 ← better

Tally: Pinecrest Edge better on 0/8; Marlstone Edge better on 8/8.
